subject: Pilot kickoff: LumenAI technical acceptance gates & owners
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@lumenai.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot kickoff: LumenAI technical acceptance gates & owners

Sam / Priya — great call earlier, thanks for the time. This thread captures the agreed pilot window, concrete acceptance gates, owners, and immediate open risks so we have a single place to track next steps. High level: 2-week pilot window (June 7–20) focused on classification throughput and inference latency for your production-like dataset.

Planned success criteria (must be met for pilot sign-off):
- Latency: median 95ms for 95th percentile requests at 50 RPS synthetic load
- Throughput: sustained 48k tokens/min during peak runs
- Data isolation: model endpoints in your VPC with logs retained for 30 days
- Quality: top-1 classification F1 >= 0.88 on holdout test set you provide

Owners: 
- Redwood technical lead / infra: Rishi Malhotra (will own infra setup, test harness, and live load tests)
- Customer technical lead: Priya Desai (will provide dataset, infra access and verify results)
- Customer success / outcome: Marissa Cole (onboarding, weekly demos, acceptance)
- Sales escalation & procurement: me (Avery) — single point for commercial/SLAs

Immediate action items before June 7:
1) Priya: confirm data subset location and provide S3 access + sample (by 2027-05-26)
2) Rishi: provision a dedicated pilot endpoint in us-west-2 and share test credentials (by 2027-05-28)
3) Marissa: draft evaluation checklist & runbook (I attached an initial acceptance workbook)
4) Procurement: Sam / procurement@lumenai to share standard PO terms or request redlines (by 2027-06-02)

Known risks and mitigations (quick list):
- Risk: Customer firewall blocks required egress to Redwood-managed control plane. Mitigation: Rishi will provide a network diagram and we can use a reverse-proxy / peered VPC option.
- Risk: Model quality variance on long-tail categories. Mitigation: run two focused validation batches; if F1 < 0.85, we do a joint triage and allow a one-week remediation window.
- Risk: Procurement delay. Mitigation: allow a soft-start (no-bill) pilot pending PO within 30 days; escalate to me for exceptions.

Attachments: redwood_pilot_acceptance.xlsx (initial acceptance criteria and test plan), network_diagram_redwood.png

If that all looks right I’ll kick off infra provisioning and schedule the first technical dry-run for June 2.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@lumenai.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumenai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: LumenAI technical acceptance gates & owners

Thanks Avery — this is helpful and aligned with our expectations. Quick clarifications: 
1) On the latency target — is the 95ms median measured on per-request time including network RTT from our VPC, or is that server-side only? We need to be explicit for our internal benchmarks.
2) We can provide a 50k-record holdout and S3 read-only creds by Wednesday (2027-05-26). Priya is looping in procurement to start paperwork.

We may also have a corporate requirement to have logs forwarded to our Splunk instance (not stored in Redwood). Is log-forwarding supported for the pilot or would that require a Private deployment?

I’ll attach the initial compliance questionnaire separately this afternoon.

—Sam
Sam Torres
Director of ML Engineering, LumenAI
sam.torres@lumenai.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Torres <sam.torres@lumenai.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumenai.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: LumenAI technical acceptance gates & owners

Sam — good questions. To be precise: the 95ms number is server-side request processing (tokenization + model inference + response generation) measured at Redwood’s endpoint. We’ll publish both server-side and client-observed RTT during load tests so you can account for network hop time.

On log-forwarding: we can stream structured request/response metadata to a customer-owned SQS/Kinesis or push via HTTPS webhook to Splunk HEC for the pilot. That’s not blocked and doesn’t require Private deployment, but we’ll need the endpoint details and a short network test.

Next steps from infra side: I’ll provision a c4 group with single-model pinned config and enable prefix caching. I’ll share temporary credentials and a runbook by 2027-05-28. If we hit a perf blocker during dry-run, plan is: (a) collect KV cache profile, (b) run an A/B with quantized variant, (c) temp throttle traffic while we triage.

Rishi
Sr. Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumenai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-24T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: LumenAI technical acceptance gates & owners

Thanks — we’ll send the S3 sample and access by EOD Wednesday (2027-05-26). A couple of items to flag from our side: 
- We require an audit log export for all inference calls (at least metadata) for compliance. Will the 30-day retention Redwood mentioned include an export capability?
- Our security team will want to run a short questionnaire and possibly an IP allowlist verification. I’m attaching the initial questionnaire.

If you can confirm the export path (SQS or Splunk HEC) that will help our security team sign off faster.

PRIYA
Priya Desai
Lead Platform Engineer, LumenAI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@lumenai.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumenai.com>
Date: 2027-05-26T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: LumenAI technical acceptance gates & owners

All — I updated the acceptance workbook with more detailed test cases and assigned owners for each gate. Summary of additions: 
- Test case 3 (long-tail categories): added 3 targeted batches and a metric dashboard widget; owner = Priya for labeling verification, Rishi to run validation harness.
- Test case 5 (throughput ramp): added a safety cutoff: if token error rate > 1.5% at 75% of target throughput we stop the run and open a triage.
- Evidence artifacts: test logs, sample outputs, and perf traces to be uploaded to the shared drive link in the workbook.

I’ve left comments for the team and requested Priya confirm the sample schema. If we get the S3 link today I’ll schedule the dry-run on June 2 at 10:00 PT.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@lumenai.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumenai.com>, procurement@lumenai.com
Date: 2027-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: LumenAI technical acceptance gates & owners

Quick update and escalation path in case we hit a blocking issue during the pilot: 
- Level 1 (Triage): Rishi + Priya — 1-hour SLA to respond and collect logs.
- Level 2 (Engineering escalation): Marissa + Redwood runtime team — 4-hour SLA to propose mitigation (fallback model config, throttling, patch).
- Level 3 (Commercial escalation): Avery + Sam — 24-hour SLA to agree remedial commercial terms (cr credits or pilot extension) if issue prevents acceptance.

If procurement can send the PO draft to me this week I’ll loop legal for any fast-tracked redlines. Otherwise, we’re good to move forward with the dry-run on June 2.

Thanks everyone — see you on June 2 at 10:00 PT for the dry-run.

Avery
